milestones.quote: Denver-based Vantage Data Centers on Wednesday broke ground on its 672-acre data center campus with four buildings near Interstate 43, around 27 miles north of Milwaukee.

OpenAI Stargate Wisconsin.note: Epoch gives no address. Its first Selected Source, the developer's campus page, places the site in Port Washington, Wisconsin.
OpenAI Stargate Wisconsin.quote: Located in Port Washington just 30 minutes from Milwaukee, Wisconsin, this landmark AI campus is Vantage’s first in the Badger State.

first_report.note: Epoch's Selected Source, 'Updated December 6, 2024'. Epoch's Gazette source names SNA LLC as the developer of the data center on the north side of 76th Avenue SW, the site's street. Epoch's first row is 2025-01-17.
